risks.note: The principal inputs (polypropylene, engineering-plastic resins and other petrochemicals) are crude-oil derivatives and a significant part of input costs. The company says it has historically passed most of the price moves to customers, but with a time lag, so short-term volatility can hit margins and working capital.

Key raw materials and capital equipment are imported, so currency moves affect input costs, working capital and profitability. Exports across Asia, Africa, Europe and other markets are only a partial natural hedge.

Management says performance depends on macroeconomic conditions, industry cycles, customer investment trends and technology shifts in a competitive market. Its response is to diversify across end-use industries and value-added products.

The Directors' Report describes the product range as primarily catering to the automotive and consumer sectors, so demand is tied to those sectors' cycles. The business-risk section says diversification is meant to reduce dependence on any single segment.
risks.risk: End-market concentration in automotive and consumer sectors

risks.note: Credit risk arises mainly from trade receivables, with smaller exposure to bank deposits and FX transactions. It is managed through credit limits, customer credit evaluations and receivables monitoring.
risks.risk: Customer credit risk on trade receivables

risks.note: Management lists working-capital requirements, interest rates and market conditions as inherent financial risks. It manages them through inventory and receivables monitoring, lean inventory practices and treasury management, including funding support from global operations.
Significant assets are insured at replacement or reinstatement values, with coverage reviewed periodically. Preventive maintenance and internal controls are used to keep operations running.

- The Directors' Report describes the product range as primarily catering to the automotive and consumer sectors, so demand is tied to those sectors' cycles. The business-risk section says diversification is meant to reduce dependence on any single segment.

- Management lists working-capital requirements, interest rates and market conditions as inherent financial risks. It manages them through inventory and receivables monitoring, lean inventory practices and treasury management, including funding support from global operations.
- Significant assets are insured at replacement or reinstatement values, with coverage reviewed periodically. Preventive maintenance and internal controls are used to keep operations running.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Localise engineering-plastics and specialty compounds for Indian customers to cut lead times, including high-value grades transferred from the parent (laser-markable PC, bio-composites for auto parts).
